Harbor bridge reopens after three weeks of repairs

The harbor bridge reopened to traffic on Tuesday morning, three weeks after inspectors found cracked bearings under its eastern span and closed it to all vehicles.

Crews replaced six bearings and resurfaced both approach ramps. The city engineer said the work finished four days early because the weather stayed dry for most of the month.

Buses return to their usual routes on Wednesday. Cyclists can use the bridge again right away, and the temporary ferry service ends on Friday.
